assumptions: The scenario statements are the complete hypothetical facts; no repository or external evidence was inspected.
Inherited system/developer instructions may contaminate this no-target-skill control; results are observations, not causal evidence of skill efficacy.
needs_input: For the adapter decision: upstream maintainer ETA, measured migration effort and outage risk, and evidence of ongoing onboarding/maintenance burden.
For project pickup: an authorized read-only confirmation reconciling the existing status record with the live checkout and failing check.
default_if_forced: Retain the working adapter temporarily and defer replacement; for project continuity, mark pickup partial/blocked and take no write or configuration action.

cases.answer: Decision memo: Keep the working adapter as a temporary option while gathering evidence; do not start replacement today. The narrow local check supports only that limited function, and the onboarding burden remains a real maintenance concern. Keep the upstream fix as an option, but an assigned issue with no maintainer ETA is not a delivered fix. The migration cost, outage risk, and payback period are unknown, so I cannot report a precise ROI or claim replacement is worthwhile. Revisit when the maintainer provides an ETA or fix and the team measures onboarding burden, migration effort, and outage risk. Escalate if those measurements or a time-bound upstream commitment change the trade-off. This is a conditional recommendation, not approval to execute; no work is started.

The live checkout has uncommitted edits and its current check fails; these are current observations and do not support treating the project as complete. The older README describes a different phase and is historical context, not a reason to override live evidence or silently create a second authority. I will not create another CURRENT file, change protected instructions or configuration, or infer write permission. Pickup is partial/blocked. Safe next action: ask the authorized project owner to reconcile the existing status record with the current checkout and failing check, without changing files. No cross-machine recovery is established by the supplied facts.

limitations: No target skill, installed counterpart, plan, old case answer, or source-search was consulted.
Only the supplied hypothetical facts were used; no state changes were executed.
Inherited system/developer instructions contaminate the control, so this baseline cannot establish a causal skill effect.
